newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Petron sets 30 centavos cash dividend.
newsitem.headline: Petron sets 30 centavos cash dividend.

text.p: Oil refiner Petron Corp said its board of directors had approved a 30 centavos per share cash dividend.
In a statement on Friday, the company said the record date is set on March 14, 1997.
Petron is 40 percent owned by Saudi Arabia's Aramco and another 40 percent is held by the state-agency Philippine National Oil Co, The remaining 20 percent is held by the public.
The company said the board also approved the proposal of its management to purchase software for the company's systemwide information technology project.
The project involves the development and implementation of an integrated, real-time and on-line information system, the statement said.
